meta.title: DeepSeek Whale Girl
meta.description: A chibi DeepSeek whale-girl desktop pet in the bottom-right corner: animated idle, waving and jumping, tap to talk, drag to move. Right-click to configure an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible AI relay, check OpenCode Go allowance and usage-pace forecasts, or review token usage. Community fan art by YunYueSama.
